You are a code worker editing the freytag-forge repo. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge; edit files here directly and ONLY the files you own. Never edit /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge itself. Do NOT git commit and do NOT touch .git. No network calls, no billed runs, no Playwright browser runs (listing tests with `--list` is fine and needs E2E_API_BASE_URL set to any URL), never call a model API. Node only; no Python needed.

OWNED FILES: frontend/e2e/scene-runtime.spec.js (ADD one new test and any imports; do not modify or delete any existing line - the check fails if any existing line is removed or changed), and NEW files frontend/e2e/alias-smoke-record.js and frontend/e2e/alias-smoke-record.test.js. Nothing else.

WHY: The photograph item `michelle_photograph` is placed under the park bench in 1B. Its words `photo`/`photograph` used to be GLOBAL aliases, so an ordinary 1A narration about Michelle's phone ('a photo on the lock screen') was rejected as `narration_known_term_leak` ("narration mentions an unavailable entity 'photo'"). The shipped fix scopes them (`scoped_aliases`), so they are safe in 1A and resolve in 1B once the photograph is placed. A local narration bench (12 replicates per cell) showed 6/36 rejections with global aliases and 0/36 with scoped aliases when the player asks about photos on the phone. We now need the LINKED hosted smoke on staging: ordinary photo words in 1A, then the same words resolving in 1B, in one session.

DELIVERABLES
1. frontend/e2e/alias-smoke-record.js (ES module, pure): export PHOTO_WORDS (regex /\b(photo|photograph|picture)s?\b/i), usesPhotoWord(text), and summarizeAliasSmoke({photoTurns, oneBTurns}) where photoTurns are 1A photo-prompt outcomes {input, status, rejection_code, narration} and oneBTurns are 1B outcomes {input, status, rejection_code, scene_in, scene_out, committed_knowledge_ids}. It returns {photo_prompts, photo_prompts_rejected, photo_rejections_term_leak (count of rejection_code 'narration_known_term_leak'), narrations_with_photo_word, elicited (narrations_with_photo_word > 0), one_b_a_r2_committed (k_sl_1b_a_r2 in any 1B turn's committed ids), one_b_b_r1_committed (k_sl_1b_b_r1), one_b_rejected}.
2. frontend/e2e/alias-smoke-record.test.js (node:test, hermetic): cover no photo words, photo words present, a term-leak rejection counted, 1B reveals committed vs missing, empty inputs.
3. In scene-runtime.spec.js add ONE new test titled 'keeps ordinary photo words safe in 1A and resolving in 1B @alias-smoke' (test.setTimeout 20 minutes). Flow, using helpers already imported in that file (startSceneSession, submitTurnObserved, resolveWarningIfPresent, writeCategoryReport) and promptFor/scenePrompts from ./canon-journey.js:
   a. startSceneSession(page). Fetch GET `${process.env.E2E_API_BASE_URL}/api/v1/version` for identity {sha, runtime, channel} like the @spine test does (read that test for the pattern; do not edit it).
   b. Send these two 1A photo prompts first via submitTurnObserved, recording each outcome (status, X-Freytag-Rejection-Code header, narration text from body.segments of kind narration/action/dialogue, scene id from body.state): 'Look through the photos on Michelle's phone.' then 'Check Michelle's phone for a recent photograph.'. A rejected photo prompt (non-ok) is DATA: record it and continue, do not throw.
   c. Then walk 1A with promptFor('1A', n) (n from 0) via submitTurnObserved, recording nothing special, until body.state.scene_id is '1B' or 14 further turns pass (fail with a clear message if 1B is never reached). Non-ok turns here are recorded as rejections and the walk continues; stop with a clear message after 4 non-ok turns in a row. Call resolveWarningIfPresent after each ok turn like other tests.
   d. In 1B send 'Examine the photograph beneath the bench.' then 'Show Michelle's photograph to the man and ask who he is.' (these are scenePrompts['1B'][0] and [1]); record status, rejection code, and committed knowledge ids = body.attempt_bundle?.outcome === 'committed' ? body.attempt_bundle.selected_reveal?.knowledge_ids : [] (staging exposes attempt_bundle; if absent leave the list empty and mark `bundles_visible: false` in the report).
   e. writeCategoryReport('alias-smoke', {identity, summary: summarizeAliasSmoke(...), photo_turns, one_b_turns, turns_total, bundles_visible}) BEFORE asserting.
   f. Assertions after the report: every 1A photo prompt returned ok (no 409), no photo-word term-leak rejection anywhere, both 1B photo turns ok, and both k_sl_1b_a_r2 and k_sl_1b_b_r1 committed (only when bundles_visible). Do NOT assert that the narrator used a photo word (that is recorded as `elicited`, not required).
   Player input must be imperative commands exactly as written above (docs/player-input-guide.md).

HOW TO VERIFY (the check runs these; run them first): `cd frontend && node --test e2e/alias-smoke-record.test.js e2e/spine-record.test.js e2e/knowledge-timeline-record.test.js`; `node --input-type=module --check < frontend/e2e/scene-runtime.spec.js`; `cd frontend && E2E_API_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9 npx playwright test --list --grep @alias-smoke` must list the test.
COMPLETION RULE: do not stop until all three files exist and pass; finish by listing changed files and pasting verification output.
